title: Understanding Animal Behaviour on Safari
excerpt: Learn to read the bush: what animal behaviour tells you, from alarm calls to a lion's twitching tail.
body:
## Alarm calls

Monkeys, birds and impalas give alarm calls when they see a predator.

## Vultures

Circling or landing vultures can point to a kill.

## Ears and tails

- An elephant with spread ears may be warning.
- A lion with a twitching tail may be agitated.

## Hunting

Cheetahs crouch and stalk; lions work together.

## Patience

Waiting at a waterhole often reveals a lot.

## Ask

Your guide can explain behaviour. See [what a good guide does](/blog/meet-your-safari-guide/).
